changeSet.author: nexus-wnpet
changeSet.comment: CREATE OR REPLACE nexus.gc_expire_quarantine(dim, tenant, quarantine_collection, origin_collection, cutoff, floor_fraction, floor_min_chunks, force) RETURNS TABLE(expired bigint, refused bigint): a past-cutoff quarantined chash still named by a catalog_document_chunks manifest row in the origin collection is now refused (never hard-deleted, never overridable by force), mirroring gc_restore_rereferenced's own rescue predicate. Signature and return shape unchanged.
